title: The Aesthetic Titan Rehab
author: Mohamed kc
desc:
Each 4-week block, one muscle is prioritized to ~18–20 sets. All others hold steady under 16.
Weeks 1–4
Upper chest
Program runs as-is. Incline is always your first and best movement every pressing session.
Weeks 5–8
Back width
Add 1 set to Straight-Arm Pulldown and Single Arm Row. Add Wide Pulldown to Day 5. Reduce chest by 3 sets.
Weeks 9–12
Side delts
Add light cable laterals to Day 3 warm-up (3x15). Increase Day 4 lateral sets to 5. Reduce chest by 2 sets.

ex.note: Arms nearly straight. Full stretch at top, hard squeeze at bottom. Best lat width builder with zero spinal loading.
Any back discomfort: bodyweight or assisted only. Do not push this one through pain.
Chest on pad = zero lower back involvement. Your safe mass builder for back thickness.
External rotation at end of pull. Critical for shoulder health and posture after 8 hours standing.
Elbows at 70°, not flared. Slow controlled descent for maximum upper chest stretch.
Cables at floor level, pull up and across. Best upper chest isolation with a full stretch at the bottom.
Cable behind body, slight forward lean. Most effective side delt isolation available.
Most important exercise for your pelvic tilt. Full squeeze and posterior tilt at the top.
Feet mid-to-high on platform. Left knee must not cave inward — control every rep.
Do not snap the knee at lockout. Builds VMO, directly helps left knee tracking.
Load (phase 1): Bodyweight. Legs swing behind you, upper body fixed. This DECOMPRESSES the spine — it pulls the vertebrae apart. The only lower back exercise that actively relieves SI joint
Bodyweight only. Rise only to neutral spine — do not hyperextend past it. Squeeze glutes hard at the top. Phase 1: feel the erectors engage, not the lumbar. Pause 1 second at the top each rep.
Hip hinge pattern with zero spinal loading. Teaches glute engagement and corrects anterior pelvic tilt.
Lower back MUST stay flat on the floor the entire time. Slow and deliberate. Directly corrects anterior pelvic tilt.
Very light weight. Anti-rotation core stability. Directly stabilizes the SI joint area.
Rope attachment. Lean slightly forward for maximum long-head stretch.
Full hang at the bottom — maximum bicep stretch on every rep.
Dumbbells not barbell — no spinal compression. Pause and squeeze hard at the top.
Lighter than Day 1. Chase the stretch and feel, not the weight.
No added weight on this day.
